call_points.text: Ceramics FY27 growth guidance raised to 23-25% from 15-15.5% on SOFC, metallized cylinders and engineered ceramics.
Metallized substrate facility with an anchor customer and technology tie-up is being set up in FY27, with revenues from FY28.
Semiconductor fab equipment ceramics supplies start small in FY27, pick up in FY28 and are expected to peak in FY30.
Ceramics PBIT stayed flat as fuel and alumina costs rose and new semicon and aerospace lines carried unabsorbed costs.
Foskor Zirconia exit options to be closed by Q2; Awuko winding-up targeted within about a quarter.
Management declined to give project-wise capex split or individual revenue contributions from SOFC and metallized cylinders.
Consolidated sales expected to grow by 4% to 4.5% in FY27 (11-12% excluding Foskor and Awuko).
Company plans to incur a capex of about ₹400 crores in FY27 for various capacity expansions.

operating_notes.text: Carborundum Universal recorded exceptional impairment and winding-down costs of ₹134.57 Cr in Q4FY26.
Foskor Zirconia Pty Limited, a subsidiary of CIL (51% stake), is winding up operations due to commercial unviability.
Company plans ₹400 Cr capex for FY27.
Completed acquisition of 29.58% equity stake in Putrim Renewables Private Limited for ₹6.48 Cr.
Standalone Electrominerals exports moved from about 35% of the business last year toward a 40% trajectory.
Foskor Zirconia contributed ₹235 Cr and Awuko about ₹108 Cr of FY26 revenue, together ₹343 Cr, and both are being exited.
Metallized substrate facility with an anchor customer and technology tie-up is being set up in FY27, with revenues from FY28; semicon fab equipment ceramics expected to peak in FY30.

timeline.summary: Carborundum Universal announced that its step-down subsidiary Foskor Zirconia is winding up operations, prompting a ₹16 Cr asset write-down.
Carborundum Universal Limited hosted an Investor Call on 15th May 2026 at 11:00 a.m. (IST) with audio recording available via the provided link.
Carborundum Universal hosted its Q4 FY26 earnings call on May 15, 2026, reporting full-year consolidated revenue of ₹5,149 Cr.
Carborundum Universal completed the acquisition of a 29.58% stake in Putrim Renewables for ₹6.48 Cr.

On its 10 August 2026 Q1FY27 call, CUMI reported consolidated sales of ₹1,411 Cr (+16.9% YoY) and PAT of ₹76 Cr (+23.4%), raised FY27 Ceramics growth guidance to 23-25% and retained about ₹400 Cr capex guidance.
